Your holdings: SOXL is down nearly 50% and SPAL is down over 37%, both leveraged ETFs that decay and amplify losses, especially on margin. SMH is also down almost 10% and needs attention.

Watch: Keep a close eye on bond market stability and any further news impacting the chip sector, given your concentration.

Bottom line: Manage your leveraged positions aggressively and respect your stops, as drawdowns on margin hurt extra.
plays: SOXL: Down 48.58%, a leveraged ETF. Consider trimming or exiting if it doesn't recover soon, given decay and margin exposure.
SMH: Down 9.97%. Respect your 540 stop; trim as planned if it breaks to protect capital.
MU: Scanner shows an ACCUMULATE setup. Consider MU at entry 937.5-935.92 with a stop at 927.36 if looking to add to chips.
